explanation: Fires on the stem that follows a prefix or first element of a compound, mostly in verbs: co-host, day-dream, jump-start, mis-interpre(ting), Re-establish, re-develop, vér-ifie(z), mis-print; also on whole verbs such as 'prolong', 'instruct', 'Cancel'. A few excerpts (Sexual Assault, Attorney General, \infty) are second pieces of fixed multi-token terms.
